subject: MAP: Data handling milestone — owners, timing, and compliance asks
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya@healthsync.com>, Tom Ellis <tellis@healthsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Data handling milestone — owners, timing, and compliance asks

Hi Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our mutual action plan (attached), I pulled together a focused milestone for Data Handling & Compliance so we have clear owners, dependencies, and a target close date for procurement.

Summary (actionable items in the attachment HealthSync_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Target close date (MAP milestone): 2026-05-10 — goal is to have contractual terms and technical controls agreed so procurement can finish by the end of Q2.
- Ownership: HealthSync (Priya) — confirmation of retention/PHI scope; Redwood (Ben) — technical controls and evidence; Redwood Security (Karthik) — SOC/SecQ attachments and audit trail specs.
- Key asks from HealthSync:
  - Confirm whether PHI will be processed/stored (Y/N) and which data elements are considered PHI/PII.
  - Required retention window for logs and user data (default we proposed 90 days for content, 24 months for audit logs).
  - Any specific residency/regulatory constraints (e.g., state-level rules or BAA required).

Dependencies & notes:
- If PHI is in scope, we will need an executed BAA before onboarding and a short list of controls (encryption at rest, TLS in transit, key management).
- Audit trail format: Redwood provides immutable event logs (ISO timestamps, user id, request id). We can export CSV/NDJSON or provide access to audit console. Retention for logs is configurable; MAP suggests 24 months default with the option to shorten for cost.
- Evidence pack: Redwood can provide the security snapshot (redwood-security-snapshot.pdf) and SOC2 metadata; Karthik will own delivering any additional attestation.

Next steps (please confirm by EOD Fri):
1) Priya — indicate PHI scope and retention preferences.
2) Tom — note any procurement-specific docs you need on top of the MAP.
3) Ben/Karthik — draft the compliance annex language (to get legal started) and list of evidence items.

I'll follow up with a short updated MAP after I get answers; attaching the editable MAP workbook for you to annotate.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachment: HealthSync_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Priya Desai <priya@healthsync.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tellis@healthsync.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Data handling milestone — owners, timing, and compliance asks

Laura —

Appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers from our side:
- PHI: Yes, limited PHI will be processed (patient identifiers + limited health codes). We'll need BAA.
- Retention: Clinical payload should be retained for 7 years for some state compliance; logs can be 24 months but we may request 36 months for certain audits.
- Residency: US-only for now; we cannot have data served from EU/APAC.

I'll review the MAP workbook and annotate the PHI elements by EOD Thu. Tom will flag procurement requirements — I think a short compliance annex + BAA is the main ask.

One follow-up question: do you support field-level redaction/partial tokenization before storing? That would help minimize PHI exposure.

Best,
Priya
Director of Product
HealthSync Inc

Priya — thanks for the quick answers and the clarity on PHI/residency. A few concrete replies and owners from Redwood:

- BAA: We support BAAs. I'll loop Legal to prepare a draft annex. Owner: Ben (submit draft by 2026-04-19).
- Retention windows: We can support 7-year content retention and configurable audit log retention up to 36 months. Owner: Karthik (provide config options and cost delta by 2026-04-16).
- Field-level redaction/tokenization: Redwood has a pre-ingest redaction layer and a tokenization option via our SDK. Owner: Karthik (technical note + sample config by 2026-04-14).
- Residency: Confirmed US-only deployment for this account; operations will pin region. Owner: Monica (confirm region and any additional SLAs by 2026-04-15).
- Evidence pack: Karthik will attach redwood-security-snapshot.pdf and SOC2 references. Owner: Karthik (deliver by 2026-04-16).

I'll add these items into the MAP workbook and set the milestone target close date to 2026-05-10 as suggested. If HealthSync can confirm PHI scope and annotate the MAP by EOD Thu, that should keep us on track.

Ben Carter

Redwood Inference
